name: weather
description: Weather and climate science: forecasts for a place, ensemble probabilities, reanalysis thresholds and extremes, atmospheric rivers and cyclone tracks, cross-sections and soundings with a skew-T chart, forecast scores, AI forecasts with their checkpoint licences, and climate-model evaluation, through clio-kit's weather server and ECMWF's own weather skills (Apache-2.0, vendored unchanged).
